probe.title: Your Page Title
probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Trendspotter Tools Categories Lists Blog Submit a tool Overview Buy Trendspotter Tools Categories Lists Blog Submit a tool Overview Buy Trendspotter How we test a tool for a month The routine every tool goes through before we write a word about it. Elin Bergqvist 13 October 2026 Productivity Every review on Trendspotter starts the same way: an editor pays for the plan a normal team would buy and uses the tool for a month of real work. Not a weekend, not a demo project. The first week is for setup We install it the way you would, read the onboarding and connect it to the things we already use. If setup takes an afternoon and a support ticket, that goes in the review. Arkiv took ten minutes to index three years of notes. Others took days. Weeks two and three are for work This is where most tools change. The novelty wears off and we find out if we still open it without thinking. We keep a plain log of every time it saved us time and every time it got in the way. The last week is for the review We reread the log, check the pricing again and write. If a tool changes a lot after we publish, we test it again and say what changed at the top of the review. Tools in this post
